report.summary: Your blood report shows several abnormal values that need prompt attention. Out of 15 parameters analyzed, 10 were outside the normal reference range. 1 possible deficiency indicator(s) were flagged. This report is for informational purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.
critical_alerts: Fasting Blood Glucose is critically high (114.31 mg/dL) — please consult a doctor promptly.
report.doctor_consultation_reason: One or more parameters are in the critical range.

deficiencies.title: Low Calcium
deficiencies.explanation: Your Calcium (8.39 mg/dL) is below the healthy reference range, which may indicate a deficiency. Important for bones, muscles, and nerve function.

health_risks.title: WBC Count out of range
health_risks.explanation: Your WBC Count (12.19 10^3/uL) is above the healthy reference range. White blood cells fight infection; high counts can signal infection or inflammation.

health_risks.title: Platelet Count out of range
health_risks.explanation: Your Platelet Count (22.5 10^3/uL) is below the healthy reference range. Platelets help your blood clot; very low or high counts need medical attention.

health_risks.title: Fasting Blood Glucose out of range
health_risks.explanation: Your Fasting Blood Glucose (114.31 mg/dL) is above the healthy reference range. Blood sugar after fasting; consistently high levels can indicate prediabetes/diabetes.

health_risks.title: HbA1c out of range
health_risks.explanation: Your HbA1c (6.19 %) is above the healthy reference range. Reflects your average blood sugar over the last ~3 months.

health_risks.title: Total Cholesterol out of range
health_risks.explanation: Your Total Cholesterol (81.86 mg/dL) is below the healthy reference range. A measure of fats in your blood linked to heart disease risk.

health_risks.title: LDL Cholesterol out of range
health_risks.explanation: Your LDL Cholesterol (32.97 mg/dL) is below the healthy reference range. 'Bad' cholesterol — high levels raise heart disease risk.

health_risks.title: Triglycerides out of range
health_risks.explanation: Your Triglycerides (20.48 mg/dL) is below the healthy reference range. A type of fat in blood; high levels are linked to heart disease.

health_risks.title: Vitamin D out of range
health_risks.explanation: Your Vitamin D (132.57 ng/mL) is above the healthy reference range. Supports bone health and immunity; low levels are very common.

health_risks.title: SGPT (ALT) out of range
health_risks.explanation: Your SGPT (ALT) (1.05 U/L) is below the healthy reference range. A liver enzyme; elevated levels can indicate liver stress or damage.

exercise: 30 minutes of brisk walking / cardio, 5 days a week (consult your doctor first).
Post-meal 10-15 minute walks to help regulate blood sugar.
hydration: Drink at least 2-3 liters of water daily unless advised otherwise.
sleep: Aim for 7-8 hours of quality sleep each night, with a consistent bedtime.
stress_management: Practice 10 minutes of deep breathing, meditation, or yoga daily.
Take regular breaks from screens and prioritize downtime.
lifestyle: Get a routine annual health check-up.
Maintain a consistent sleep and wake schedule.
Include at least 30 minutes of physical activity most days of the week.
